inShort: A feeds from the kitchen line, and B resets from midcourt: first from one spot, then on the move as A spreads the balls.
rules: A stands at the kitchen line, B in midcourt.
Round 1: A feeds calm balls, and B resets each one into the kitchen from the same spot.
Round 2: A spreads the balls: forehand, backhand, middle, line, wide. B moves, sets up and resets.
Train forehand and backhand resets in separate blocks of 10.
tooEasy: A raises the pace and hunts for errors. Even harder: B starts at the baseline.
tooHard: A throws the balls by hand from close range.
goodLooksLike: B is set before every ball, and the resets land low in the kitchen.

drill.title: Progression Drill — Reset/Third off a Live Feed
